extensionAttribute.description: End time of the most recent PresSTORE backup, with error count.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # PresSTORE Last Backup End Time Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
nsdchat="/usr/local/aw/bin/nsdchat"
if [[ ! -x "$nsdchat" ]]; then echo "<result>Not installed</result>" exit 0 fi
cd /usr/local/aw 2>/dev/null || exit 0 workstation=$("$nsdchat" -c Server names 2>/dev/null) lastend=$("$nsdchat" -c Server "$workstation" lastend 2>/dev/null) lasterror=$("$nsdchat" -c Server "$workstation" lasterror 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -n "$lastend" ]]; then isoDate=$(/bin/date -j -f %s "$lastend" "+%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S" 2>/dev/null) if [[ "$lasterror" == "<empty>" || -z "$lasterror" ]]; then echo "<result>Last backup ended $isoDate with no errors.</result>" else echo "<result>Last backup ended $isoDate with $lasterror error(s).</result>" fi else echo "<result>No backups recorded</result>" fi
